description: The engine for each job and each Librarian actor, behind `browse:engines`: a provider and a model, and no credential. It is the knowledge base's Inference document's `engines` as they stand, with no fallback, so a job or an actor absent here has no engine.

jobs.description: The engine each job is done with when software does it, keyed as a job description is: by `jobType`, and for `mark` by motivation.

mark.description: The engine for `mark` jobs of each motivation.

actors.description: The engine each Librarian actor that calls a model asks.
